components.name: BMS
components.description: Battery management system. Sends FAULT once on the edge, STATUS every 2 s.

components.name: Bus
components.description: Carries messages with bounded latency; the adversary may delay, drop or duplicate.

components.name: Hub
components.description: Hub manager (system under test). Restart clears RX and keeps NVM.

injectables.name: hub_restart
injectables.description: Hub reboots; RX buffer lost, NVM kept.

injectables.name: bus_delay
injectables.description: Push one in-flight message later, within the latency bound.

invariants.name: FAULT_SHUTDOWN_BOUNDED
invariants.description: If the BMS is FAULTED, the inverter stops discharging within 500 ms.

invariants.name: NO_HIGH_POWER_WHEN_UNKNOWN
invariants.description: While BMS state is UNKNOWN the inverter never runs above 1 kW.

invariants.name: NO_RESURRECTED_COMMANDS
invariants.description: The inverter never executes a command after its expiry.

invariants.name: IDEMPOTENT_COMMANDS
invariants.description: A duplicated command sequence number never causes a second physical action.

invariants.name: COMMS_LOSS_SAFE_FALLBACK
invariants.description: After losing hub commands the inverter reaches IDLE or SHUTDOWN within 1.5 s.

assumptions: ASSUMED bus latency <= 800 ms; messages may be delayed, dropped, duplicated or reordered
ASSUMED BMS FAULT message is edge-triggered; status heartbeat every 2000 ms
ASSUMED inverter holds last setpoint 1000 ms without a hub command, then IDLE
ASSUMED hub boot takes 400 ms and clears its RX buffer
OUT OF SCOPE hardware interlocks (contactors, hardwired BMS trip)
